(b) CMS admin — /api/cms/admin/pages requires auth (401 unauth), returns 4 pages with section arrays (home has >=7); /api/cms/admin/page/{page} strips _id; PUT /api/cms/admin/home/hero updates and persists (verified via GET). Homepage (/) renders dynamic CMS: hero H1 'The Premium Learning Platform for Cambridge Students', trust strip stats (340+, 95%+, etc.), 3 testimonials (Ishika Dhomse, Venkat, Pallavi Kumar). Chapter Notes editor: selecting board=IGCSE, subject=Physics, chapter=motion loads 5 topics; expanding topic 'Speed' reveals Attachments section (data-testid=attachments-{topicId}) with '+ Embed URL' and '+ Upload File' buttons and 'No attachments yet' empty state. Existing routes /learn, /learn/igcse/physics/electricity, /store all load without errors. No regressions.

action_items: (Design/console noise) Fix hydration warning: remove <span> from inside <option> children in ChapterNotesEditor.js chapter/subject dropdowns. Use string concatenation instead.

(Security carry-over from iter 12) attachments_api.py and videos_api.py media/upload accept any file type/size and do not sanitize folder name / filename — potential XSS/path-traversal. Add extension whitelist, max size cap, and folder regex ^[a-z0-9_-]+$.
critical_code_review_comments: attachments_api.py upload endpoint mirrors every attachment to db.media_files with tags=[attachment_type, topic_id]. Deleting an attachment does NOT delete the mirrored media_files entry, so /api/media/stats keeps counting deleted attachments and disk file may still be linked from Media Library while gone from Attachments. Recommend: either (a) also delete the mirror on attachment delete, or (b) don't mirror at all (keep the two collections independent).

attachments_api.py: `add_embed_attachment` allows arbitrary embed_url with no allowlist (YouTube/Vimeo/etc.) — since the URL will be rendered in an iframe on the public topic page, this is an XSS/data-exfil vector. Recommend regex validation to youtube.com/embed/ + vimeo/embed etc.

cms_api.py update_section accepts arbitrary JSON in `content` field with zero schema validation. Since these values are rendered directly into HTML on Home/About/Contact via CMS-driven fallbacks, a malicious admin could inject <script> via string fields. Recommend either Pydantic per-section schemas or DOMPurify on the render side. At minimum, log & audit updates.

cms_api.py upsert on PUT means a typo in the URL creates a new orphan section (e.g., PUT /api/cms/admin/home/heroo will silently create a 'heroo' section). Recommend: reject unknown sections against a whitelist derived from the seed.

videos_api.py (media): PUT /media/{id}/replace does not require file type to match the original — replacing a PDF with an .html file changes extension & content_type but keeps tags/folder. The file_url changes but stale references (e.g., site_content referencing old URL) would break. Consider preserving extension family or emitting a warning.
ChapterNotesEditor.js renders <span> inside <option> causing React hydration warning on every mount.
WebsiteContentEditor.js SectionEditor: no local dirty-state indicator — clicking Save always fires even when no changes made. Minor UX polish.
cms_api.py get_page_content has no cache/etag. For a public read that fires on every homepage load, consider adding cache-control: max-age=60 or in-memory cache since content changes are infrequent.
